report.answerForRuling82a: Only the FIRST ledger-writing Stop against a given git common dir spawns powershell.exe (4 spawns, all spawnSync, all via windows-private-state.mjs > private-boundary.mjs > fanout-ledger.mjs > stop-fanout.mjs, i.e. ensureLedgerDirectory -> ensurePrivateDirectory on directory CREATION). A second real-process Stop against the already-existing common dir (same session, and also a different session) spawns 0, with the same block decision and a real ledger append, so the 0 is a measurement, not a fail-open. A Stop where enforcement is not required (boolean requiresEnforcement:false) takes the silent path, writes no ledger event, does not even create the ledger directory, and spawns 0. This matches the code reading in fanout-ledger.mjs:170-194 (existing directory = lstat branch only) and the predecessor's FANOUT-WIN-F finding. Consequence: the backlog item's premise 'on every Stop' does not hold in steady state; SF22 pins 4 only because every SF22 sandbox is a fresh common dir, so SF22 can only ever observe the first-Stop case.
